claim: The BFP public warning says it does not accredit or recommend any brand, store or distributor of fire extinguishers/fire-fighting equipment. Its warning prohibits personnel from selling or recommending a specific fire-extinguisher brand.

claim: The image panel says portable fire extinguishers are regulated by DTI through BPS and that each type must comply with appropriate Philippine National Standards for product safety/reliability. This supports no BFP brand accreditation; it should not be expanded into a claim that any product is suitable regardless of type or hazard.

evidence.source_span:
Portable Fire Extinguishers are regulated by the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) through its Bureau of Products Standards (BPS)
PARTS

There are 4 types of fire extinguishers available in the country. To be sure of product safety and reliability, each type must comply with the appropriate Philippine National Standards (PNS).
